scope: Independent photo source QUALITY gate on user-shot iPhone 16 Pro JPGs already uploaded to conversation; NOT fidelity measurement
reference_confidence: Only Cool Rose IMG_6707 and Amber IMG_6729 associated by adjacent screenshots. Neither filename/EXIF alone confirms style and slider settings. Screen recording shows browser in viewfinder, not a 4096-patch per-style target.
available_color_metadata: EXIF ColorSpace=1 (sRGB) and pixel dimensions; no usable exposure, WB, timestamp or device camera settings, and no embedded ICC in the shared JPEGs.
color_accuracy_limitations: Standard baseline was photographed in a different session from candidate Apple styles
Automatic exposure/white balance and monitor spectrum/profile were not locked or measured
Some pixel-to-patch alignments are approximate and many points have channel clipping
RGB photo proxy differences cannot establish exact Apple Photographic Style ISP or on-device YCam fidelity
3000 trillion repeated surrogate comparisons are computationally impractical and cannot resolve insufficient ground truth

validation_additional.interpretation: Same-image bootstrap sensitivity check, NOT 10000 independent photos, Apple deltaE2000, or guaranteed percentage accuracy

production_decision.reason: Do not make new global style/color changes or claim 1:1 Apple accuracy without photo/slider correspondence and matched, controlled Standard + native style + YCam photo pairs.

privacy: Derived aggregate metadata only. Raw private phone photos, video and EXIF are not committed to GitHub.
